reviews.author: Lynn Lane
reviews.text: We are so happy with the work Jaime and his crew at Vientos Painting did for us. From the beginning, it was clear Jaime truly cares about quality and doing things the right way. His crew took great care in prepping the surfaces, taping, sanding, spackling, and smoothing everything so it looked brand new. The final paint job is beautiful with crisp lines, even coverage, and a clean, professional finish. Jaime’s communication was outstanding. He kept us informed every step of the way, which is rare with contractors, and made everything easy and stress-free. I also appreciated how mindful he was about paint quantities so we didn’t overbuy anything unnecessary. They worked long days, finished ahead of schedule, and delivered excellent work at a very fair price. Truly conscientious, professional, and detail-oriented. Highly recommend Vientos Painting.

reviews.author: D Schneck
reviews.text: First let me say that I am an artist, and probably the pickiest client when it comes to painting a house. Our newly-purchased 12 year old house needed some work done to the ceiling, where seams were starting to show, and nails were pushing out the drywall in certain places on the walls. Imperfections were also visible where the ceiling met the walls. Jamie and his crew meticulously taped and drilled, and spackled and sanded these spots and made them look as smooth as new! The prep work they did to the surfaces before painting was outstanding. Their painting was top notch: straight lines, even coverage, everything done to perfection. We are so happy with the work they did, their professionalism from start to finish, the reasonable price, and they even finished ahead of schedule, working long hours each day. Jamie is a good communicator and conscientious hard worker, you will get the best if you hire Vientos Painting!

reviews.author: Shenna Hess
reviews.text: I needed a last minute interior paint job done on a home. Called these guys and was able to get a very reasonable quote the same day along with the job starting the following day. Finished the entire home in 2 days. Will be using them again for future work.

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.text: Jamie did an excellent job painting our house! He is so much more than just a" paint guy", he repaired our drywall, removed borders,etc..and and made sure everything was just how we wanted it. Also did an amazing cleanup job! I'd recommend Jamie and his guys to anyone!

reviews.author: Joan Blackburn
reviews.text: Vientos Painting is exceptional not only for their skills but for their pricing. Every appointment was not only on time but early, plus the job was completed early. Jamie came twice before the job was started to help me pick the right color to correct problems left by other contractors. My 30-year-old cedar siding house looks like new. The crew worked like a well-oiled machine. They gave great care for perfection, caulking and repairing the boards as they stained. They covered windows, doors and other items before starting the job. If they found a problem, they notified me and repaired it. Example: fixing an outside light that was loose among other things. When the job was complete, they had me review the job to make sure everything was to my specification. When they finished, everything was cleaned, and you could not tell they had been on the property. They have my highest recommendation!

reviews.author: Glenn Carpenter
reviews.text: Quick response with estimate. Very fair price. Started job within a week. 3000 sq ft house and 1400 sq ft barn two coats of stain plus trim, gutters, doors done in two weeks. Junior, Alex, and Freddy did an excellent job and were fantastic to work with.

reviews.author: Kristyn Ballard
reviews.text: Jaime is prompt, professional, and honest! He and his crew worked hard to finish our home interior in a timely manner. When they finished, I couldn’t even tell they had been in the house! The completed project is beautiful! I would definitely recommend Viento’s Painting to anyone looking for a reasonably priced and excellent job!

reviews.author: Vonda Johnston
reviews.text: Jamie and his team did a wonderful job on our new home. His attention to detail was amazing. He and his employees were very professional and pleasant. We will definitely use them in the future and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a painter!!!

reviews.author: Suzanne Riddleberger
reviews.text: Viento’s gets an A+++There is nothing average about these guys except their price which is extremely fair and reasonable. Jamie and his crew took great care to restore my home to new and I was completely in awe when I saw how hard these guys worked to give attention to every little detail. They weren’t just painting they were perfecting what I had like an artwork. My 200 year old wainscoting and trim had thick chipping paint and they restored it to absolute perfection along with helping me pick colors and even went so far to give me example walls with the colors I thought I might like so I could see if I liked them. I loved everything they choose but one of the colors I personally picked they had already put in 2 rooms and I asked if I could change them for me and they graciously immediately took care of it for me. I am overwhelmed with this company and you absolutely can not go wrong having Viento’s on the job.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: Junior and his crew did an outstanding job painting the interior of our home. Several rooms, high ceilings. They work hard all day long, and the job turned out great. Really appreciate their dedication and attention to detail. I would use them again in a minute and would recommend them to anyone.

reviews.author: Kip Kak
reviews.text: We used Viento’s for a townhome we were selling. They did such a wonderful job. When we were ready to sell our other townhomes they were sadly booked up a month and we had to get them on the market. So we had to hire a different company. Not only was Viento’s a much better price, they did a much better job. Also they used the less expensive paint and the other company we hired bought the most expensive paint and did a sloppy job. We won’t ever cheat on Viento’s again, even if they are booked months out.

reviews.author: Melissa Blinn
reviews.text: Junior responds quickly and does an EXCELLENT job. He worked hard all day long along with another very hard worker. Their attention to detail was well appreciated. He was reliable and I would definitely recommend him!

reviews.author: Chelsea Kline
reviews.text: Can’t say enough great things about Viento’s, they did an amazing and detailed job, made recommendations for us, provided us with an accurate and affordable estimate. We are so thrilled with how the house turned out.

reviews.author: McKenzie May
reviews.text: Extremely friendly, professional, and easy to work with. We will definitely be using them again in the future!

reviews.author: Brian Wilmoth
reviews.text: Junior & team did a great job painting my house at a reasonable price. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Pauline Rhodes Beery
reviews.text: I highly recommend Viento’s Painting... just had my bedroom repainted and Jamie did an amazing job for a great price!
